text:
maria.partners: Kicking off CloudX marketplace integration thread. Key items: minute vs hourly granularity, HMAC signature header, entitlement mapping (sku vs ent_id), idempotency/backfill policy, and reconciliation thresholds.

aj.ops: do they send event_id? retry behaviour? timezones?

maria.partners: Older agents lack event_id. Retries: exponential w/ jitter up to ~5 tries. Timestamps are ISO8601 w/ offset.

devon.eng: proposal: accept minute pulses to a minute buffer keyed by tenant+minute, async rollup to hourly ledger. Dedupe: prefer partner event_id, else compute sha256(tenant+sku+timestamp). Store raw payload for audits. Normalize timestamps to UTC but keep original string.

aj.ops: signature header is `X-CX-Signature: sha256=HEX`. HMAC over raw body. Watch whitespace canonicalization.

lia.product: mapping doc: cloudx.sku -> redwood.sku + pricing_tier. If ent_id missing, infer from SKU and tag `provenance=inferred`. Inferred events cannot auto-credit during backfill without manual sign-off.

devon.eng: backfill policy: if partner supplies historical hourly rollups we will run a shadow ingest, compute delta vs ledger. Auto-apply ledger adjustments only if delta <= 0.2% and <= 1000 units; otherwise create manual review ticket with raw events and partner slice.

sam-infra-bot: staging endpoint deployed at https://staging-webhooks.internal.redwood/cloudx, helm webhook-cloudx:v1.2. Run `./tools/webhook-test --partner cloudx --file samples/cloudx-minute.json` to exercise.

maria.partners: Action items: @devon.eng implement minute buffer + dedupe + provenance flag in staging; @aj.ops add verifier + replay scripts; @lia.product prepare mapping CSV and reconciliation playbook; I'll request partner hourly exports for 2026-03-18..2026-03-20 and confirm if rollups are computed from minute pulses.

aj.ops: metrics: record `pct_inferred_ent_id` and `daily_reconcile_mismatch_pct`. Run 72h shadow ingest then compare counts.

devon.eng: also add idempotency/logging: event_id source, computed_id, and raw_event_ref.

maria.partners: will follow up with CloudX and attach export here. Closing when export attached and first shadow run completes.
